files.README.md:
# Clarion Water Services - field service log

One row per technician visit. downtime_hours is the time the treatment
system ran below spec, recorded by site telemetry and confirmed at
handover.
files.notes/contract_terms.txt:
Response targets run from the first alarm in the hourly telemetry queue.
Sites on the harbor loop keep spare valve kits on site; everything else
draws from the central storeroom. Weekend visits need the duty manager's
sign-off.

turns.prompt: Clarion Water Services is reviewing which failure modes drive the most downtime. The service log is at service/visit_log.csv. Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. What was the average downtime, in hours, for visits with a Valve issue in September 2026?
